plugin.name: Mr Agent
plugin.description: AI chat for CPN. Host or Site install with per-user Host isolation. Folder /mr-agent/ by default; vhost takeover only with CONFIRM=yes. MCP skills, floating bubble, storage/resource limits.
plugin.keywords: ai, mcp, skills, assistant, openai, anthropic, chatbot, model context protocol, host install, mr-agent
plugin.author: master3395

features.feature: In-site chat UI with provider and model picker
OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and custom base URL providers
Free lightweight CPN help and menu search without a paid key
Panel-wide MCP tool surface with per-area skills under skills/
Active skills: Help/Menu, Providers, Websites list, Packages list
Stub skills: Email, DNS, PHP, Plugins, Accounts
Owner ACL: admins only, all users, or package id list
Floating chat bubble in CPN Panel when enabled and ACL allows
Storage and resource limits: retention, disk MB cap, rate/token/concurrency, local timeouts
CLI prune for chat logs under /var/lib/cpn/mr-agent/<domain>/chats/
Host install: panel chat without site docroot takeover
Site folder mode under /mr-agent/ without replacing the site index
Optional vhost mode with explicit CONFIRM=yes (never silent)
First-class local LLM (Ollama, LM Studio, Bionic) on the CPN server
Per-user data isolation on Host (and Site): sites, mailboxes, packages scoped to the signed-in CPN account

plugin.uninstall_impact: Site /mr-agent URL stops working when folder publish is removed
Vhost mode restores the previous document root on uninstall.sh
Chat app under the site or host plugins folder is removed
Floating bubble disappears from CPN Panel
Secrets under /var/lib/cpn/mr-agent/ remain until cleaned manually
